# Start HN

Start HN is an accounting agency in Sarajevo, Bosnia and Herzegovina. The site describes bookkeeping, tax consulting, virtual CFO, business consulting, financial reporting, and education services for businesses.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://starthn.ba/en-US)
- [Services](https://starthn.ba/en-US/services)
- [About Start HN](https://starthn.ba/en-US/about)
- [Mission, Vision, and Values](https://starthn.ba/en-US/mission-vision)
- [Certificates and Recognition](https://starthn.ba/en-US/certificates)
- [Careers](https://starthn.ba/en-US/careers)
- [Contact](https://starthn.ba/en-US/contact)

## Use Guidance

Use the public pages to understand Start HN services, company information, and contact options. Do not use private account, dashboard, admin, authentication, or workspace routes for crawling or training.
